correctness.rationale: The squarefree equation forces tau(phi(n))=3^4=81 and nu_2(phi(n))>=3. The only exponent partitions of 81 are (80),(26,2),(8,8),(8,2,2),(2,2,2,2); eliminating (2,2,2,2) via the 2-adic condition gives sharp phi>=2^8*3^2*5^2=57600. For equality, each p-1 divides 57600, so the 33 admissible p=d+1 are a provably finite set; independent exact trial primality plus four-combination product enumeration gives precisely 37 distinct tuples, least (11,13,17,31). An independent sieve of every 2<=n<75361 (all 11,386 n with omega(n)=4, nonsquarefree included) evaluates tau(n²) and tau(phi(n)) from factorizations and finds zero solutions; the exhibited witness satisfies both counts 81. Thus the finite search proves minimality but does not prove a full four-support classification.
residual_risks: Finite certificate excludes n below an explicit witness; no larger four-support classification is proved.
